{{Quote|...I will live nowhere at all, where the Applebright has found me. She has gathered my last few fragments to caress and console and restore in her rich baskets of nutritions, and she promises me that sometimes, when she is the Witch and I am inside her, she will show me the world again.|Excerpt from The Feast Fulfill'd}}
'''The Applebright''' is one of the [[Hours]]. She is a God-from-[[Nowhere]]. She watches over the Grove of Green Immortals, a mountain monastery of renegade Taoists, specialized in horticulture and medicine. She is believed to be the counterpart of [[The Flowermaker]], and has an association with [[The Witch-and-Sister]].

==Notes==
*In ''[[Cultist Simulator]]'', The Applebright is currently only mentioned once by name in [[Endgame conditions#The Feast Fulfill'd|The Feast Fulfill'd Major Victory]].
*Applebright was confirmed as an Hour, in Weather Factory's blog posts on the development of their upcoming related game, "Book of Hours": https://weatherfactory.biz/mar-2-folio/
*Due to the scarcity of lore concerning The Applebright in ''[[Cultist Simulator]]'', her status was a point of contention among the community. Some believed "The Applebright" is only an alias of The Flowermaker and/or The Witch-and-Sister. Conversely, proponents of her Hourhood argued that ''[[A Catalogue of Uncharted Pleasures]]'' explains The Applebright's origin: while some "sparks of delight" generated by [[The Forge of Days]] wafted to [[The Glory]] and became The Flowermaker, more of those same sparks also drifted into [[Nowhere]] to manifest as The Applebright.
